The 11th Gaudí Awards ceremony, presented by the Catalan Film Academy, was held on 27 January 2019 at the  in Barcelona. The gala was hosted by .
Background
The nominations were read by David Verdaguer and Núria Prims on 11 December 2018 at La Pedrera's auditorium. In addition to the magic tricks performed by the gala host, the illusionist Mag Lari, the ceremony featured musical performances by , Alfred García, and Elena Tarrats.
The live broadcast on TV3 attracted about 289,000 viewers in Catalonia (15.4% audience share).
